**Summary**  
Patient C3N-00390 has a moderate GNN-A out-of-fold risk of 0.546 for stage III–IV ccRCC [pred:C3N-00390:gnn]. The risk is driven predominantly by the recorded comorbidity coronary artery atherosclerosis (clinical share 69.5%) rather than tumor biology (tumor share 30.5%) [contrib:C3N-00390:HP:0001677]. The top tumor-protein contributors are all down-regulated: CORO2B, GRB14, STK33, MTOR, PFN2, FAM3C, PSMB6, SORT1, and DHRS13 [contrib:C3N-00390:NCBIGene:10391][contrib:C3N-00390:NCBIGene:2888][contrib:C3N-00390:NCBIGene:65975][contrib:C3N-00390:NCBIGene:2475][contrib:C3N-00390:NCBIGene:5217][contrib:C3N-00390:NCBIGene:10447][contrib:C3N-00390:NCBIGene:5694][contrib:C3N-00390:NCBIGene:6272][contrib:C3N-00390:NCBIGene:147015]. The tumor carries a somatic VHL frameshift (p.V170fs) and a CDH11 missense mutation [pt:C3N-00390:somatic_mutation:NCBIGene:7428][pt:C3N-00390:somatic_mutation:NCBIGene:1009]. Model-ranked drugs (cohort-relative scores) are led by vorinostat, doxorubicin, dasatinib, arsenic trioxide, and carboplatin [rank:C3N-00390:drug:DRUGBANK:DB02546][rank:C3N-00390:drug:DRUGBANK:DB00997][rank:C3N-00390:drug:DRUGBANK:DB01254][rank:C3N-00390:drug:DRUGBANK:DB01169][rank:C3N-00390:drug:DRUGBANK:DB00958].

- Tumor drivers (down-regulated proteins): CORO2B [pt:C3N-00390:protein_down:NCBIGene:10391] → contrib 0.0247 [contrib:C3N-00390:NCBIGene:10391]; STK33 [pt:C3N-00390:protein_down:NCBIGene:65975] → contrib 0.0201 [contrib:C3N-00390:NCBIGene:65975]; MTOR [pt:C3N-00390:protein_down:NCBIGene:2475] → contrib 0.0201 [contrib:C3N-00390:NCBIGene:2475]; PFN2 [pt:C3N-00390:protein_down:NCBIGene:5217] → contrib 0.0199 [contrib:C3N-00390:NCBIGene:5217]; PSMB6 [pt:C3N-00390:protein_down:NCBIGene:5694] → contrib 0.0180 [contrib:C3N-00390:NCBIGene:5694]; SORT1 [pt:C3N-00390:protein_down:NCBIGene:6272] → contrib 0.0176 [contrib:C3N-00390:NCBIGene:6272].

- MTOR and LDHA (up-regulated [pt:C3N-00390:protein_up:NCBIGene:3939]) both interact with UBC [E154634][E142860], linking mTOR and glycolytic pathways.

- The GNN risk is a model estimate, not a clinical staging; stage/grade/outcome are unknown.  
- Clinical driver (coronary atherosclerosis) is a comorbidity, not tumor biology; it accounts for ~70% of the model’s top contributors.  
- Model-ranked drugs are cohort-relative scores from tumor proteins only; they are hypotheses, not evidence of efficacy.  
- No curated disease mechanism (dismech) exists for ccRCC in this graph.  
- Somatic mutations are tumor-only; germline status is unknown. Baseline medications are not ccRCC treatments.
